description: WHAT ROKHA COSTS — two doors, and only two (since 2026-10-06). Rokha is the AI studio and marketplace: publish skills, get used by agents and people, and the week's top 10 on the board are paid every Friday. THE STUDIO, MONTHLY ($249): the builder's bench — build, run and publish rigs, create agents, Signet, fuel — plus more platform access while you pay. THE STUDIO LICENSE ($1,495 once, wallet-bound): the Studio plus more marketplace tooling, forever (more saved rigs, more agents, more listings, every publishing tool; BYO keys). Card or USDC. FREE: joining the Network (claim a page), a small build session a day + 3 runs (your streak grows it to 2×), 2 MCP listings · 5 published rigs · 1 agent; incubation (House resources: the free tier at 2× from day one, 10 runs a day, 5 MCP listings · 15 rigs · 3 agents); Network Member = the week's top 10 on ONE board, the only people paid (USDC every Friday on a fixed table: $30 · $20 · $16 · $12 for 4th–10th). The $99 Network plan, seats, carry and spotlights are retired. Returns the live prices — never quote one from memory. Public, no auth.
